title: Construction of PDA@Ag-Coated Gutta-Percha for Root Canal Therapy
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Root canal therapy is currently the leading treatment method for endodontic and periapical diseases. Gutta-percha (GP), the most widely used root canal filling material, is inert and biocompatible; however, it suffers from the lack of antibacterial ...
